# Accordion

Expand or reduce a content section.
See [Accordion guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/accordion/design/)

To build an `Accordion`, use the <LinkTo kind="Components/Collapsible" story="docs">Collapsible</LinkTo> component.
